data.long_meaning: Reuven means 'friend.' In the Old Testament, Reuven is the name of the eldest son of Jacob and Leah. He was a strong and brave man who protected his family. The name Reuven carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Reuven usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of loyalty and brotherhood.
data.etymology: Reuven belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Reuven total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: The name Reuven holds deep cultural significance in the Jewish community, as it is one of the twelve tribal names and the name of the firstborn son of Jacob. The legend of the stern and protective elder brother Reuven is often told in Jewish literature and folklore. This name continues to be a significant part of Jewish tradition and identity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Reuven is rooted in the notion of brotherhood and friendship. It is a reminder that bonds between loved ones are strong and essential in life. In the Christian faith, this name is a symbol of the love and care that God has towards His children. Reuven serves as a reminder to us to love and care for one another, as brothers and sisters in Christ.
